reason: I already paid for a big learning app and my son stopped opening it within weeks, so I will not pay ₹299 a month again until I see him actually using this one on his own. The free report is useful, but YouTube and free apps can cover those gap topics.
objection: After the pilot ends and the teacher stops pushing it in class, my child will stop using it at home and I will be paying for nothing, just like last time.
would_change_my_mind: If the teacher shows me at the parent-teacher meeting that his weak topics actually improved during the free pilot, and the school keeps using it in class so he keeps practising.
